title: New Affordable Housing in Cortez Hills!
description:
Dozens of new affordable homes have opened to San Diegans in Cortez Hill. Jacaranda on 9th is a Bridge to Home program investment that converts an outdated hotel into safe, stable housing with on-site support!

Permanent Supportive Housing units, project-based vouches and long-term affordability will help residents rebuild stability. 

#SanDiego #BridgeToHome
